title: CTFSolve-assisted capture-the-flag challenges
summary: Cybersecurity participants work through capture-the-flag challenges with a web application that accepts challenge text or images and generates tailored hints. The authors deployed the tool during the Kosovo cyber team's preparation for the 2024 European Cyber Security Challenge.

sources.title: Leveraging AI for CTF Challenge Optimization

assessment.summary: Solve practical capture-the-flag challenges with optional hints generated from submitted challenge descriptions or files.
